Fixed deck restoration feedback.

### Download

**[Download BetterCollectionManager.dll for BepInEx](https://github.com/UltiKon/Better-Collection-Manager/releases/download/0.3.1/BetterCollectionManager.dll)**

For an existing **BepInEx 5 Unity Mono** installation. Replace the DLL in
`BepInEx/plugins/BetterCollectionManager/` and restart Hearthstone.

### Fixes

- Successfully restored decks disappear from **Archived** with the native deletion animation, effect and sound.
- Stay in **Archived** instead of switching automatically to **Saved**. Keep the current scroll position.
- Removal still waits for a successful server save and matching contents readback. The restored Saved deck remains intact.
- Prevent conflicting archive navigation and actions during the removal animation.

### Other downloads

- [BepInEx package](https://github.com/UltiKon/Better-Collection-Manager/releases/download/0.3.1/BetterCollectionManager-0.3.1-bepinex.zip) — DLL, source, documentation and checksums.
- [MelonLoader package](https://github.com/UltiKon/Better-Collection-Manager/releases/download/0.3.1/BetterCollectionManager-0.3.1-shareable.zip) — matching MelonLoader DLL, source, documentation and checksums.

Both loader variants contain the same fix. Use one loader variant per launch.
Existing preferences and local archives are preserved.

### Validation

Both Release builds, loader metadata/configuration checks, managed regression suites,
native API metadata checks and package integrity checks are verified before publication.
Managed fixtures cover successful and rejected restoration, keeping the archive view
and preserving the restored server deck. Native animation/audio rendering needs
client-side verification.

See the [installation guide](https://github.com/UltiKon/Better-Collection-Manager/blob/0.3.1/README.md#how-to-install).
